sources.title: Model Downloads and Assets | Lightricks/LTX-2 | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Asset Management and Hub Integration The ltx-trainer package provides utilities for managing these assets and pushing fine-tuned models back to the HuggingFace Hub. Pushing to HuggingFace Hub The function push_to_hub handles the end-to-end process of uploading trained weights, generating a model card, and attaching validation samples.
